title: The actual proper pushforward restricts to the localizing hulls
statement:
Fix a universe u, a prime $\ell$, and a field $k$ in universe u of positive
characteristic different from $\ell$. Let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes
and let $g:Z\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda$ be
a commutative condensed ring with its specified multiplication and a certificate
of one of the three adic coefficient families [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate].
For $T=Z,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, let $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$
be the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category
[sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], let $\mathcal B_T$ be its bounded constructible
full subcategory [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], and let
$\mathcal L_T=\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal B_T)$ be the full localizing hull, using
ambient coproducts indexed in universe u+1
[def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure].
The ambient derived pushforward $Rg_*$ sends each object of $\mathcal L_Z$ into
$\mathcal L_Y$. Thus its object and morphism maps define a canonical functor
$F_g:\mathcal L_Z\to\mathcal L_Y$ by restriction. This functor commutes with
integer shifts, is triangulated, and preserves all coproducts indexed in universe u+1.

source.place: Part (1): proper direct image on the two localizing hulls.

proof.text: Prove the general closure criterion used in Lean. If an exact ambient functor F preserves coproducts after restriction to the source hull and maps bounded source objects to bounded target objects, put P equal to the intersection of the source hull and the inverse image of the target hull. P is replete and triangulated. Lift each P-valued discrete diagram and its ambient colimit cocone to the source hull. Full faithfulness reflects its colimit property, the coproduct hypothesis maps it to a colimit, and closure of the target hull puts that image colimit in the target hull. Thus P is closed under ambient sums. Minimality of the source hull proves the claim.

Apply the closure criterion to actual Rg_*. It is triangulated as a total right derived functor. Case elimination of the indexed adic coefficient certificate supplies the existing IsFinitenessCoefficient instance in each of its three constructors. Proper bounded-constructible preservation is the proper adic specialization of boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_obj; the coproduct input is the preceding localizing coproduct theorem.

Define the restricted functor using ObjectProperty.lift and the proved membership theorem. Its shift structure and exactness are inherited by the full triangulated subcategory. Reflect preservation of coproducts along the fully faithful target inclusion, whose composite with F_g is the source inclusion followed by Rg_*.
